feeds.title: Rowing News
feeds.description: Since 1994, Rowing News has served the North American rowing community with news, results, features, training tips, and compelling images. Our award-winning print magazine, app, website, and other services deliver comprehensive and original content to the rapidly-expanding rowing market.

feeds.title: Rowing Australia
feeds.description: Rowing Australia is the peak body for rowing in Australia. RA aims to be Australia's leading Olympic sport and the world's leading rowing nation in competition, development and governance.

feeds.title: British Rowing
feeds.description: British Rowing is responsible for the training and development of rowers from grass roots level to high performance Olympic and Paralympic athletes. British Rowing is the governing body for the sport of rowing.

feeds.title: Coach Bergenroth
feeds.description: Providing Online Rowing Training Plans or Online Rowing Coaching that achieves results and enhances your enjoyment of the sport of rowing.

feeds.title: Rowing Analytics
feeds.description: The reason this blog exists is to collect and organize tips and discussions about how to analyze and use data collected during rowing to improve performance.

feeds.title: Rowing Ireland
feeds.description: Rowing Ireland is the Governing Body for Rowing in Ireland and represents over 70 Clubs across the four provinces. Rowing is one of Ireland's most successful sports, having won multiple World Championships over the last two decades.

feeds.title: Washington Rowing
feeds.description: Washington Rowing offers nationally recognized collegiate rowing programs for both women and men at the University of Washington, continuing the Husky Crew tradition of winning championships and Olympic medals.

feeds.title: Killorglin Rowing Club
feeds.description: Killorglin Rowing Club (KRC) is situated on the banks of the river Laune. The river being the venue for our water based training when the tides are right. KRC was the first club in Ireland affiliated to both rowing unions, the Irish Amateur Rowing Union (IARU) and the Irish Coastal Rowing Federation (ICRF).

feeds.title: Rowing Crazy Blog

feeds.title: Whitehall Rowing & Sail

feeds.title: Rowing The World
feeds.description: The Rowing Travel Blog explores many rowing and travel topics that will inspire, educate and entertain rowers around the world. Enjoy this rowing blog!

feeds.title: GigRower

feeds.title: Aisyah Rower Blog
feeds.description: Aisyah Gala is physical education teacher and a personal trainer and a Coach in Rowing. The girl who lives and dies for rowing.

feeds.title: Grok Rowing Blog

feeds.title: Rowing Story Blog
feeds.description: Rowing Story is here to help with this by telling the story of women's international rowing in GB from the first Women's European Rowing Championships in 1954. We bring together published facts with the personal recollections of many of those involved on the long journey to the World.

feeds.title: Laszlo Boats Nz Blog
feeds.description: Laszlo Boats NZ is New Zealand's oldest and newest rowing skiff-building company, with more than 30 years of boat-building industry experience. They understand that it's rowers who make boats go fast, but having a fast boat can help create that fractional advantage that can make the difference between gold and silver.

feeds.title: Richmond Rowing Club Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Richmond Rowing Club a vibrant, friendly and inclusive community based club. Over 100 Richmond Rowing Club members enjoy on and off water activities that provide a fun and challenging environment in which to compete and reach their goals.

feeds.description: Features articles that have to do exclusively with Rowing. Concept2 is a rowing company that manufactures indoor rowers, racing oars, the BikeErg, and the SkiErg. The goal is to promote the growth of rowing, indoors & outdoors.

feeds.title: Boathouse Blog
feeds.description: Boathouse Sports partners with the elite athletic programs and schools to provide custom, Made in USA, performance outerwear, uniform and training gear to athletes.

feeds.title: Sydney Rowing Club
feeds.description: Sydney Rowing Club was established in 1870 and was first located on the site the famous Sydney icon, The Opera House. The club has multiple dining options, uninterrupted 270 degree water views, live entertainment, a variety of indoor and outdoor seating, and is located only 50 metres from Abbotsford Wharf. Sydney Rowing Club is truly the perfect venue to enhance any experience.

feeds.title: Megan Kalmoe Rower Blog

feeds.title: Girl on the River

feeds.title: Rowing Roy Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Duncan Roy - Ocean Rowing Coach. I am a proud Yorkshireman. I discovered indoor rowing through my rehabilitation. Having rowed the Atlantic twice, and now gearing up to row in the Great Pacific Race 2021 I want to share my experiences to enable rowers to optimize their preparations & build resilience.
